changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttributeType_backup') BEGIN drop table dbo.FusionAttributeType_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttributeType_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType_backup]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(50000,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [FusionTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [TextPath] nvarchar(max), [Assignable] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionAttributeType_Assignable] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [ScanEnabled] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionAttributeType_ScanEnabled] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionAttributeType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
